reviews.x: Twice I've purchased this foundation powder and in both cases, the product cracked and disintegrated into useless chunks after just a few uses. I am careful with my makeup, did not drop it or drop anything upon it. That this happened two times suggests a problem with the product or the compact. I asked Wander Beauty for a refund and they told me to "take it up with the retailer", which sure feels like passing the buck, as this is a flaw in the manufacturing.   Don't buy this.

reviews.t: Cheap Feeling and easily comes off
reviews.x: This powder was supposedly going to be full coverage, and when I put it on, it felt like cheap drug store cover girl powder.  It didn't cover anything, and I have pretty clear skin, so I wasn't asking it to do much. Don't believe the Instagram videos!

I have had this powder compact for a little over a month and it has totally disintegrated!  It has never left my bathroom and has never been dropped.  Up until this happened, I was in love with the product, but now it is almost unusable. Very Disappointing!!

Do not buy this product unless you want to look lifeless and caked.  I bought it in medium from the company website and paid 40 bux for it.  I don't know why on earth anyone would spend 50-80 dollars on this, but that's what I am seeing on amazon.  First, the product was much lighter than most mediums I've used and it it has no warmth or natural look to it at all. If you have perfect skin to begin with, I suppose it works as an oil absorber, but you can buy wet and wild crap at the drug store an
Color match was good, but chalky, drying, and lousy coverage! Also, it's 40.00 everywhere,  don't pay 83.00! That's insane.
Just received this item a s I opened it.  Was used.  Not happy
Simply awful. I don’t even put it in my purse. It simply stays in my makeup drawer, and still it shattered!!  Don’t waste your money. You can buy crap like this at CVS and spend less money
I LOVE this makeup--it's easy to put on, can be applied lightly or more heavily and wears well throughout the day. This price is ridiculous--check their website.

reviews.t: Nice powder, light and good coverage!
reviews.x: I like this powder. It has a good coverage yet it feels light and doesn't get caky. It makes your face feel soft and you don't see you have make up on.
This stuff is awesome!  I am almost 60 and have several marks on my face. It covers unbelievable. I have tried many products and I am sticking with this one.
While the powder itself is good, the whole thing cracked and crumbled. Because of this, only had the powder for two weeks!
It’s just an ok product...elf has a similar product for $5.

reviews.t: This is the perfect Makeup that I’ve been waiting for!
reviews.x: I first discovered the Wander Selfie Powder a few months ago, and I absolutely love it...Imagine my surprise when I saw a video showing this new Wanderlust Powder Foundation, with perfect coverage, a long lasting finish, and on top of that, it’s good for your skin. I have Lupus, so I have been through my fair share of full coverage foundations, trying to find the right coverage, the right shade, and a product that can last all day without numerous applications throughout the course of my day...T

reviews.t: Best foundation ever but no longer available
reviews.x: I love the lightweight feel of this foundation and the fact that it blurs pores very well but does not settle in fine lines. Sadly, it remains unavailable for reorder in most colors and I haven’t been able to get an answer from them regarding future availability (reason for one less star)

reviews.t: Not sure it was worth it
reviews.x: Coverage was nice.  Still needed liquid foundation.  I “broke through” the powder within a week and it completely crumbled within a few days.  I am going to try the internet hack with rubbing alcohol, but I was expecting more from 40 bucks

reviews.t: Didn't have the coverage as advertised. I found it ...
reviews.x: Didn't have the coverage as advertised. I found it was actually more oily than my powder foundation I had used before (and going back to). For the price, I didn't care for it.
I’ve been using this product for many years but I’m disappointed that you dropped the Light Medium shade. The light is too light and the medium is too dark for me.
This is definitely not worth the money.  It came broken into pieces and I'm afraid to put the compact in my purse for fear of it getting all over everything.

reviews.t: The contents of this powder foundation compact crumbles
reviews.x: I have had 6 of these compacts and all of them have broken up when they were a 3rd used. I like the product but it crumbles in the compact long before it is used up, rendering it unusable.. The pictures are of 3 different compacts.

I should have listened to others’ advice; despite never having deoooed this powder, it cracked! When I try using the crumbles of the product it falls onto my clothing and looks like I spilled foundation on me. The company doesn’t care- despite their promise to return call and emails, they DON’T! Not worth the Heart price! For with MAC Studio fixe - a much better product!

Love this product! Great coverage but I think it’s pricey. The makeup part is great but the product doesn’t last long at all if you use as your makeup. I might order again for my emergency touch up bag, but for the price it doesn’t seem like you get much. I just had it a few weeks before I could see the bottom of the compact and I don’t use it daily.

I like the coverage and it works exactly as described.  One huge complaint, for the price I paid, I am very disappointed in the amount of powder that is in the compact case. Within a week of use, the middle started cracking and I noticed it is hollow inside. I would not purchase again.

This is the second time I've ordered this and the second time it's been broken when it comes.  The compact powder is in pieces.  I will keep this because I can still use it but I prefer to have it in one piece.
This product is amazing. Even for dry skin it just looks like my skin but filtered. A must try.

reviews.t: Not completely what I expected for the money
reviews.x: Covers very well but powder broke up in the compact so hard to apply now

claims.text: Many reviewers report the powder compact cracks, crumbles, or disintegrates after only a short time, even without being dropped.
Several reviewers praise the coverage and lightweight feel, saying it wears well and doesn't look cakey.
Some reviewers complain the product is chalky, drying, and provides poor coverage.
Multiple reviewers warn that the price is too high and advise checking the company website for a lower price.
A few reviewers mention issues with color match or receiving a used item.
